title: Walmart Canada Offers Deals on Various Products
summary: Walmart Canada is holding a "Deal Days" event, offering discounts on a range of products. News outlets are highlighting specific deals available during this promotion.
title_hi: वॉलमार्ट कनाडा विभिन्न उत्पादों पर छूट दे रहा है
